# whisper/append

Extend-don't-duplicate knowledge into the right file.

## Protocol

1. Search first — check the target file for an existing note on the topic
2. `turu append <scope> --text "..."` — appends verbatim, creates parents
3. Extend or correct existing notes instead of adding duplicates; no secrets, ever
